astronomy_picture_of_the_day.title: Shadow and Rainbow
astronomy_picture_of_the_day.explanation: At sunset, an alignment of rainbow and mountain shadow was captured in this remarkable snapshot. The stunning view was recorded from a fire lookout on Smith Peak in the Plumas National Forest near Portola, California on July 13.
